candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record clearly describes palatal myoclonus, which is a key component of Progressive Ataxia and Palatal Tremor (PAPT). However, the candidate only captures the palatal myoclonus and omits the progressive ataxia, which is also a major part of the reference diagnosis and well-supported by the 20-year history of progressive ataxia and examination findings.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Palatal Myoclonus is a component of PAPT, but the candidate misses the ataxia and the progressive nature of the full diagnosis.
